#!/bin/bash
set -u
# -------------------------------------------------- # 1. Configuration # --------------------------------------------------
DATA_URL="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SiegeEngineers/aoe2techtree/master/data/data.json" STRINGS_URL="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SiegeEngineers/aoe2techtree/master/data/locales/en/strings.json" ICON_BASE="https://aoe2techtree.net/img/Civs"
# Alfred provides this when the workflow has a Bundle ID. # The fallback is portable and contains no personal paths. if [[ -n "${alfred_workflow_data:-}" ]]; then ASSET_DIR="$alfred_workflow_data" else WORKFLOW_ID="${alfred_workflow_bundleid:-com.aoe2techtree.lookup}" ASSET_DIR="$HOME/Library/Application Support/Alfred/Workflow Data/$WORKFLOW_ID" fi
DATA_FILE="$ASSET_DIR/data.json" STRINGS_FILE="$ASSET_DIR/strings.json" CIVS_JSON="$ASSET_DIR/civs.json" ICON_DIR="$ASSET_DIR/icons"
UPDATED_STAMP="$ASSET_DIR/data.updated" CHECK_STAMP="$ASSET_DIR/data.checked" LOCK_DIR="$ASSET_DIR/.refresh-lock"
mkdir -p "$ASSET_DIR" "$ICON_DIR"
# -------------------------------------------------- # 2. Helpers # --------------------------------------------------
write_stamp() { local target="$1" local tmp="${target}.tmp.$$"
date +%s > "$tmp" && mv "$tmp" "$target" }
is_due() { local file="$1" local interval="$2" local last now
[[ -s "$file" ]] || return 0
last=$(cat "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) [[ "$last" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || return 0
now=$(date +%s) (( now - last >= interval )) }
valid_data() { [[ -s "$1" ]] && jq -e ' (.civs | type == "object") and ([.civs[] | select(.era == "base")] | length > 0) ' "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 }
valid_strings() { [[ -s "$1" ]] && jq -e 'type == "object" and length > 0' \ "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 }
valid_civ_cache() { [[ -s "$1" ]] && jq -e ' type == "array" and length > 0 and all(.[]; (.title | type == "string") and (.subtitle | type == "string") ) ' "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 }
# -------------------------------------------------- # 3. Build local civilization names + descriptions # --------------------------------------------------
build_civ_cache() { local data_source="$1" local strings_source="$2" local output_file="$3"
jq --slurpfile strings "$strings_source" ' [ .civs | to_entries[] | select(.value.era == "base") | . as $civ | ( ($strings[0][($civ.value.help_string_id | tostring)] // "") | gsub("(?i)<br\\s*/?>"; "\n") | split("\n")[0] | gsub("<[^>]*>"; "") | gsub(" "; " ") | gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$"; "") ) as $description | { title: $civ.key, subtitle: ( if $description == "" then "Civilization" else $description end ) } ] | sort_by(.title | ascii_downcase) ' "$data_source" > "$output_file" }
# -------------------------------------------------- # 4. Refresh source data and local descriptions # --------------------------------------------------
refresh_data() { local tmpdir
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d "$ASSET_DIR/.refresh.XXXXXX") || return 1
# Record the attempt to avoid repeated network requests. write_stamp "$CHECK_STAMP" || true
if ! curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 4 --max-time 15 \ "$DATA_URL" -o "$tmpdir/data.json"; then rm -rf "$tmpdir" return 1 fi
if ! curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 4 --max-time 15 \ "$STRINGS_URL" -o "$tmpdir/strings.json"; then rm -rf "$tmpdir" return 1 fi
if ! valid_data "$tmpdir/data.json" || ! valid_strings "$tmpdir/strings.json"; then rm -rf "$tmpdir" return 1 fi
if ! build_civ_cache \ "$tmpdir/data.json" \ "$tmpdir/strings.json" \ "$tmpdir/civs.json" || ! valid_civ_cache "$tmpdir/civs.json"; then rm -rf "$tmpdir" return 1 fi
# Install source files first and the ready-to-use cache last. if ! mv "$tmpdir/data.json" "$DATA_FILE" || ! mv "$tmpdir/strings.json" "$STRINGS_FILE" || ! mv "$tmpdir/civs.json" "$CIVS_JSON"; then rm -rf "$tmpdir" return 1 fi
rm -rf "$tmpdir"
write_stamp "$UPDATED_STAMP" || true return 0 }
# -------------------------------------------------- # 5. Download missing icons in parallel # --------------------------------------------------
download_icons() { valid_civ_cache "$CIVS_JSON" || return 1
jq -r '.[].title' "$CIVS_JSON" | xargs -P 8 -I '{}' /bin/bash -c ' CIV="$1" DIR="$2" BASE="$3"
NAME=$(printf "%s" "$CIV" | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]") ICON="$DIR/$NAME.png" MARKER="$DIR/$NAME.missing"
if [[ -s "$ICON" ]]; then rm -f "$MARKER" exit 0 fi
# Retry failed downloads after seven days. if [[ -f "$MARKER" ]]; then MARKER_MTIME=$(stat -f "%m" "$MARKER" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) NOW=$(date +%s)
if [[ "$MARKER_MTIME" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( NOW - MARKER_MTIME < 604800 )); then exit 0 fi fi
TMP="$ICON.tmp.$$"
if curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 8 \ "$BASE/$NAME.png" -o "$TMP" 2>/dev/null && [[ -s "$TMP" ]] && mv "$TMP" "$ICON"; then rm -f "$MARKER" else rm -f "$TMP" touch "$MARKER" fi ' _ '{}' "$ICON_DIR" "$ICON_BASE" }
icons_need_refresh() { local civ name icon marker marker_mtime now
now=$(date +%s)
while IFS= read -r civ; do [[ -n "$civ" ]] || continue
name=$(printf '%s' "$civ" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') icon="$ICON_DIR/$name.png" marker="$ICON_DIR/$name.missing"
[[ -s "$icon" ]] && continue
if [[ -f "$marker" ]]; then marker_mtime=$(stat -f '%m' "$marker" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
if [[ "$marker_mtime" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( now - marker_mtime < 604800 )); then continue fi fi
return 0 done < <(jq -r '.[].title' "$CIVS_JSON")
return 1 }
# -------------------------------------------------- # 6. Background maintenance # --------------------------------------------------
refresh_assets() ( if ! mkdir "$LOCK_DIR" 2>/dev/null; then exit 0 fi
trap 'rm -rf "$LOCK_DIR"' EXIT
if ! valid_data "$DATA_FILE" || ! valid_strings "$STRINGS_FILE" || ! valid_civ_cache "$CIVS_JSON"; then
if is_due "$CHECK_STAMP" 3600; then refresh_data || true fi
elif is_due "$UPDATED_STAMP" 86400 && is_due "$CHECK_STAMP" 3600; then
refresh_data || true fi
# New civilizations and missing icons are handled here. download_icons || true )
# -------------------------------------------------- # 7. First-run setup # --------------------------------------------------
if ! valid_civ_cache "$CIVS_JSON"; then if ! is_due "$CHECK_STAMP" 60; then jq -n '{ items: [{ title: "Civilization list unavailable", subtitle: "A previous download failed. Try again shortly.", valid: false }] }' exit 0 fi
if ! refresh_data; then jq -n '{ items: [{ title: "Civilization list unavailable", subtitle: "Check your internet connection", valid: false }] }' exit 0 fi
# First run: download the initial icon set. download_icons fi
# -------------------------------------------------- # 8. Start background updates when necessary # --------------------------------------------------
NEED_MAINTENANCE=0
if ! valid_data "$DATA_FILE" || ! valid_strings "$STRINGS_FILE" || ! valid_civ_cache "$CIVS_JSON"; then
if is_due "$CHECK_STAMP" 3600; then NEED_MAINTENANCE=1 fi
elif is_due "$UPDATED_STAMP" 86400 && is_due "$CHECK_STAMP" 3600; then NEED_MAINTENANCE=1 fi
if icons_need_refresh; then NEED_MAINTENANCE=1 fi
if [[ "$NEED_MAINTENANCE" -eq 1 ]]; then refresh_assets </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & fi
# -------------------------------------------------- # 9. Return all results; let Alfred filter locally # --------------------------------------------------
MATCHES_FILE="$ASSET_DIR/.matches.$$" trap 'rm -f "$MATCHES_FILE"' EXIT : > "$MATCHES_FILE"
while IFS=$'\t' read -r CIV DESCRIPTION; do [[ -n "$CIV" ]] || continue
CIV_LOWER=$(printf '%s' "$CIV" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]') ICON_PATH=""
if [[ -s "$ICON_DIR/$CIV_LOWER.png" ]]; then ICON_PATH="$ICON_DIR/$CIV_LOWER.png" fi
printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' \ "$CIV" "$DESCRIPTION" "$ICON_PATH" >> "$MATCHES_FILE"
done < <(jq -r '.[] | [.title, .subtitle] | @tsv' "$CIVS_JSON")
jq -Rn ' [inputs | split("\t")] | { items: map( . as $row | { title: $row[0], subtitle: $row[1], match: $row[0], arg: ("https://aoe2techtree.net/?lng=en#" + $row[0]) } + ( if ($row[2] // "") != "" then {icon: {path: $row[2]}} else {} end ) ) } ' "$MATCHES_FILE"

## `aoe`: take a quick look on [aoe2techtree.net](aoe2techtree.net)
## Install & Configure
1. Download the latest `.alfredworkflow` from the [Releases](../../releases) page.
2. Open the downloaded file and confirm the import in Alfred.
3. This workflow uses `jq`, a lightweight command-line JSON processor. You may install it either with: 1. Homebrew: `brew install jq`, or; 2. [Alfred's built-in Dependencies Manager](https://www.alfredapp.com/help/kb/dependencies/) 4. *(Optional)* To customize the keyword, open the workflow's configuration and replace `aoe` with your preference.
---
## Fetch & Download
Upon the first run, this workflow downloads the current civ data and icons from [Siege Engineers AoE2 Tech Tree](https://github.com/SiegeEngineers/aoe2techtree) (<2MB in total) and store them in Alfred's per-workflow data directory in order to improve search speed. A background refresh checks for updates periodically.
The first invocation downloads the current civilization data, English descriptions, and civilization icons. These files are stored in Alfred's per-workflow data directory on your Mac, not in the workflow's source folder. After the initial setup, search results use the local cache; a background refresh checks for updated source data periodically.
---
This is an independent community workflow. Shout out to [Siege Engineers AoE2 Tech Tree](https://github.com/SiegeEngineers/aoe2techtree) for constantly updating and sharing the game data.
Created by: [Luk Long Man](https://github.com/luklongman)
You may replace "aoe" with keyword of your choice.
